description: Analysis code and figures for the paper Mantle plume conduits are most prominent beneath the mid-mantle viscosity increase (Müller, Fichtner and Schiller, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems). Conduits are traced as least-cost descending paths through five global tomographic shear-velocity models beneath 49 hotspots and 300 ambient locations, calibrated against injected synthetic conduits and analysed by depth against the ambient population. README.md gives the layout, the inputs, the commands and the licences.
